subject: Alden Medical — trial tiers, surge commitments, and short extension
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@alden-med.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rakesh Menon <rakesh@alden-med.com>, procurement@alden-med.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension & ask on pilot tiers

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is impressed. Were about 60% through the time-boxed pilot but have hit a procurement delay on the PO and need another 10 business days to get legal/finance sign-off. That gap would otherwise interrupt our evaluation and make it hard to show the throughput numbers to the stakeholders.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short extension (10 business days) to the current pilot end date, or alternatively a small top-up of GPU hours we can use while procurement finishes?
- If we do extend, can we get a modest concession on pricing (were evaluating conversion economics) — even a one-time credit would help our CFO justify the spend.

I attached our projected usage spreadsheet to show where we expect the bulk of tokens/throughput to land if we get uninterrupted time. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director of AI Programs
Alden Medical

[Attachment: Alden-usage-proj.csv]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@alden-med.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension & ask on pilot tiers

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for sharing the usage projection. Im glad the demo landed well. We can absolutely help avoid a gap in evaluation. Two practical options I can offer quickly while I loop in finance for sign-off: 

Option A — Short extension (preferred):
- Extend the existing time-boxed pilot by 10 business days with the current configuration.
- If you sign an addendum to convert to a paid Dedicated or Hosted contract within 30 days of the extended end date, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 20% of the pilot's pro-forma usage charges (applies only once).

Option B — Hour top-up (faster):
- Grant a one-off pool of 200 GPU-hours (usable during the current pilot window + 10 business days).
- No credit attached to this option; converts to standard pricing on conversion.

A few notes:
- If you expect consistent peak concurrency or need reserved capacity for a short spike, we can optionally put you on a small Dedicated burst reservation for the extension; that would change the economics and Id need to confirm availability.
- Either approach includes an addendum to the SOW (short form) — Ive drafted a one-page addendum I can send if you pick a path.

Im ccing Laura (sales ops) to help with the paperwork and timing. If it helps, I can also bring Stephanie from finance onto the thread to accelerate the credit approval.

Quick call? Im free Mon 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Dylan / Maya — thanks for the clarity. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/engineering: 

- Procurement: we will need an addendum and an updated SOW to process the PO. Our timeline for PO issuance is ~2 weeks (depending on legal). If we go with the extension, wed like the addendum to explicitly state the new end date and the credit mechanics.
- Engineering: curious whether the hour top-up (Option B) can be applied to the same cluster/instance types we tested; were trying to replicate the exact throughput numbers. If its a shared pool, we may see variance.

I attached a redline request from our side with small wording clarifications.

procurement@alden-med.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension & ask on pilot tiers

Thanks Rakesh — and appreciate the redline. Quick updates and a concrete path forward: 

1) Internal approvals: Stephanie (ccd) confirmed Finance is comfortable approving Option A (10 business day extension + 20% one-time credit) for deal ALD-20482 pending a signed addendum. She asked that we limit the concession to that single pilot credit and require conversion within 30 days of the new end date for the credit to be applied.

2) Technical: The hour top-up (Option B) will be provisioned on the same instance family we ran the pilot on. Its a shared pool but we will prioritize your jobs on the pilot tag during the extension window to minimize variance. If you prefer reserved burst capacity we can price that separately.

3) Paperwork: I attached a one-page addendum and an updated SOW reflecting the new end date (2026-09-03) and the credit language. Next steps:
- If youre happy with Option A, sign the addendum and return to procurement@alden-med.com and cc me; Laura will route for countersignature and trigger the extension in our system.
- If youd rather take Option B, confirm and well provision the 200 GPU-hours and send a short form confirmation.

Ive honored most of your redline requests but left two legal items for your counsel (minor liability bracket + data retention sentence) — marked in the attached SOW. Let me know if you want us to absorb either.

Apologies for the back-and-forth; we want to keep your evaluation momentum intact.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (updated), Alden-usage-proj.csv
